notes.title: AGEOD special Sales
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]Don’t miss out on our special deal on the entire AGEOD games catalog.[/b]

If you haven’t heard yet, on[b] June 4th[/b], we are releasing our new strategic 4X game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34556788/2208a629574e40e2e9d50bc0f2cd4cbab53be7cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Field of Glory: Kingdoms[/b] is the latest game from the award-winning studio AGEOD, known for creating some of the best grand strategy games of all time. Set in 1054, just after the Great Schism, it covers more than two centuries of epic European, African, and Middle Eastern history.

[b]Here's a quick overview of the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] 375 factions
[*] 325 units
[*] 600 buildings
[*] 14 religions/heresies
[*] 90 cultural traits (all new)
[/list]

If you want to learn more, follow the game on:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985050/Field_of_Glory_Kingdoms/

[url=https://discord.gg/3Xrm3ge5wQ]Join our Discord community[/url]


And don't forget to check out the Dev Diaries:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1985050/view/4178854131307887205

notes.title: Wars of Napoleon has been released on Steam!
notes.notes:
One of the best grand strategy games created by Ageod has reached a new milestone!

Wars of Napoleon is now available on Steam, and finally you’ll be able to unleash the power of the Grand Armee on this platform!

Four historically accurate scenarios with different starting points will lead you into one of the most turbulent periods in Europe’s history, covering over 10 years of military campaigns, from 1805 to 1815!

And if this wasn’t enough, you could try to succeed where even Napoleon failed:  with a what if scenario covering the French invasion of Great Britain!

Play with one of seven major nations: France, Great Britain, Prussia, Russia, Austria, Spain, the Ottoman Empire, and experience a detailed diplomacy system recreating the intricate balance of power of the time!

A very large map of Europe with over 4,000 regions and also special areas like the West Indies, North America, Persia and India will be the landscape for your plans of domination!

Will you answer when Destiny calls you?

Play the game now!

store.steampowered.com/app/459470/

notes.title: Wars of Napoleon is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[i]"Wars of Napoleon is the most complete representation of Napoleonic military strategy that I know of."  [/i][url=http://kriegsimulation.blogspot.it/2016/01/wars-of-napoleon-review.html][b]Real And Simulated Wars[/b][/url]

	Napoleonic Era has always fascinated historian and gamers alike, and strategy developer studio AGEOD wasn’t afraid to accept the challenge to create a [u]Grand Strategy game[/u] able to depict the complexity of this fundamental moment of History: [b]Wars of Napoleon![/b]


	Praised by players and press alike for its impressive level of details and immersion, the game is ready to reach a new milestone [b]with a release on Steam, in early May![/b]

	[b]Be ready to relive the epics and the scheming of the Era! Fight to the end to protect the Revolution or choose to eradicate the tyranny once and for all![/b]

	[i]In Wars of Napoleon you are [b]able to manage the complexities of army organization and logistics[/b] in a very detailed political setting, where each contender plays a vital part in the final outcome. You will play in a very large map of Europe with over 4,000 regions and also special areas like the West Indies, North America, Persia and India![/i]

	Stay tuned for further informations!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/459470

	[i]New to the game? Check out the video tutorials below![/i]

youtu.be/CmUCKpssdXQ
